newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end at 23.125 pct in liquid mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end at 23.125 pct in liquid mkt.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates closed at 23.125 percent on Tuesday in a very liquid market with the central bank's Monday repo rate cut causing little surprise, traders said.
"Market players were expecting this cut which was roughly in line with inflation figures or easing discount treasury-bill yields," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
The National Bank of Hungary cut four of its five repo and reverse repo facilities by 0.25 percentage points each on Monday, leaving only the overnight reverse repo rate unchanged.
"These cuts did little more than confirm our expectations," said Gabor Kornis of ABN-AMRO.

However, some traders said the repo cuts came somewhat earlier than expected, an opinion suppported by the fact that this time the market players did not have all available funds in the one-week reverse repo facility, as it happened prior to the last two rate cuts.
